    About this model

    Built from the builder's own drawings (ground, first and top floor, Sept 2026) with the nine changes of Rev 2. Room sizes are his labels; door swings follow his door arcs. His plans give no heights, so these are assumed from our design: plinth 3'-6" above the road, 11'-8" floor to floor, windows 3'-0" to 7'-0" (bathroom vents 5'-0" to 7'-0"), doors 7'-0", terrace walls 3'-6", roof walls 3'-0", boundary wall 7'-0" from the road. The car port is at road level. The 6'-0" front gate opens outwards because his steps start only 1'-5" inside it. Furniture is as he drew it, simplified. Not a construction drawing.
